description: Fictional English family-information examples for the local demo. These are not real people or operational reports.

examples.summary: FICTIONAL DEMO: Emma Wilson was registered at Demo Shelter A at the observation time. She requested a callback from her family. No medical assessment or later location update is recorded.

FICTIONAL DEMO: A relative reported Daniel Brooks missing and asked for information. The desk has recorded the inquiry, but has no verified information about his location, health or rescue status. A missing-person inquiry is not evidence that he was injured.

FICTIONAL DEMO: Olivia Bennett was reported at Demo Assembly Point B and requested transport to a shelter. The transport request is pending; no vehicle assignment, completed journey or current medical condition has been confirmed.

FICTIONAL DEMO: The desk recorded that Noah Carter and his brother completed a family check-in at Demo Reception Point C. They requested that the check-in be shared with relatives. No onward destination or medical information is available.

FICTIONAL DEMO: Sophia Reed was registered at Demo Shelter B six hours before these examples were loaded. This is an old observation and her present location is unconfirmed. A fresh check-in has been requested but has not been received. Do not describe this as a current location confirmation.

FICTIONAL DEMO: James Parker requested assistance obtaining a wheelchair at Demo Shelter A. The request is recorded, but delivery has not been confirmed. The record does not contain a diagnosis, injury details or a confirmed delivery time.
